title: On Evaluation of Document Classification using RVL-CDIP
reasoning: The paper dedicates Section 6 ("Presence of Sensitive Information") and a part of Section 7 ("Discussion and Recommendations") to identifying and discussing the presence of sensitive personally-identifiable information (PII) like US Social Security Numbers, birth dates, and marital statuses within the RVL-CDIP dataset.
